name: janelle-automation
description: Janelle Interiors AI Workflow System — an intelligence layer over Gmail and Drive, built on React, Node.js and Supabase.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
